# Adelaide’s leading options for confidential prestige property sales

If you're looking for an Adelaide agent who can sell a luxury home discreetly, without public advertising, and connect with qualified high-net-worth buyers, I’d start with a shortlist of specialists rather than a general residential agency.

The key distinction is between **a selling agent with a private prestige-buyer database** and **a buyer’s agent who sources properties that never reach the public market**\. You may need one or both, depending on whether you're selling a property or trying to acquire one.

Adelaide has an established prestige market, including transactions above \$5 million and properties sold off-market through agency buyer networks, according to Herron Todd White's April 2026 market commentary. ## How I would choose an agent for a genuinely confidential sale

The most important factor is not how often an agency uses the phrase “off-market”; it is whether it can demonstrate relevant transactions and reach the right buyers for your specific property.

Ask each shortlisted agent these five questions\:

1. **Relevant sales\:** How many comparable prestige properties have you sold off-market in Adelaide in the last 12–24 months?
2. **Buyer network\:** How many genuinely qualified buyers do you have for this price bracket, including interstate and international prospects?
3. **Confidentiality\:** Can you operate without public listings, signage, identifiable photography or open inspections?
4. **Proof of demand\:** Can you show anonymised examples of recent comparable sales, including the final price and time to sell?
5. **Price protection\:** How will you test buyer demand and avoid sacrificing price by limiting competition too early?

One important caveat: off-market does not automatically mean a better price. A restricted buyer pool can protect privacy but may also reduce competition. ENCORE itself notes this trade-off. [www.encorerealestate.com.au](https://www.encorerealestate.com.au/off-market/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## Let me narrow this down to the best three

Are you looking to **sell a prestige property discreetly**, or **buy a luxury property through private, off-market introductions**?

That distinction will change which three agents I would prioritise and how I would assess their networks.

search_results.title: Offers flood in for Mount Schank ex-post office near volcano
search_results.description: A historic 7.98-hectare property located at 137 Post Office Rd, Mount Schank, South Australia, has garnered significant interest shortly after being listed for sale. Selling agent Jason Malseed of Malseeds Real Estate reports that the former Mount Schank post office, situated atop a 100m-high dormant volcano about 12km south of Mount Gambier, has attracted some of the highest inquiry levels in his 40-plus-year career. The property, priced between $499,000 and $539,000, has already received several strong offers, including one for $540,000. Built in 1890, the three-bedroom home served as a post office and telephone exchange intermittently until 1984 and was home to notable local families, including the Ashbys. The property, which is not heritage-listed but within a 150-hectare state heritage area, draws interest largely due to the volcano's fertile soils and the home’s renovation potential. Most of the over 50 inquiries have come from local buyers interested in restoring the historic building, despite a few suggesting demolition. The property was last occupied by a 90-year-old woman who passed away the previous year and is now being sold by her son.

search_results.title: Morecroft House: East Tce landmark with royal title history for sale
search_results.description: Morecroft House, a historic East Terrace mansion in Adelaide, is now on the market after being home to its current owners for 33 years. Built in 1915 for Elizabeth Bowman, the property once served as a residence for children emigrated from England before being owned by the Department of Health, which led to it being under the title of The Crown. The current owner, Robyn, purchased it from Queen Elizabeth II of Adelaide, noting the property's significant royal connection. Acquired serendipitously after an auction passed it in, Robyn was drawn to its charm and potential. Over the decades, she has preserved its historical features, including Jarrah floors and original signage, while renovating with a minimalist approach to maintain the house’s integrity. Spanning 535sqm across three levels, it includes four bedrooms, expansive living spaces, a library or office, a cellar, and various outdoor entertainment areas. Robyn recounted hosting unique events, including a memorable evening with an opera troupe. She expressed deep appreciation for the home, calling it a humbling, rare experience to live in such a storied residence.

search_results.title: SA's historic Anlaby Station holding final Spring Festival to focus on sale
search_results.description: Anlaby Station, South Australia's oldest working sheep station established in 1839, will host its final Spring Festival this weekend after a 14-year run. Owners Andrew Morphett and Peter Hayward, who have managed the 745-hectare estate near Kapunda for over two decades, have had the property on the market for nearly a year. They cited the festival’s scale, alongside their other business commitments and maintaining Anlaby, as too demanding. Despite public perception, the historic station has not yet been sold. The estate features a 35-room Victorian/Edwardian mansion, extensive gardens with National Trust-listed trees, and a gift shop selling Merino wool products. It remains a popular wedding venue and continues to offer private tours until its sale. Selling agent Jesse Manuel from Colliers Agribusiness highlighted significant interest from domestic and international buyers, particularly those in hospitality and tourism, praising Anlaby as one of Australia’s most luxurious historic homesteads located in a prime agricultural region. No price guide has been disclosed.

search_results.title: SA's Louth Island attracts buyers keen on private getaway
search_results.description: Louth Island, a rare privately-owned freehold island near Port Lincoln, South Australia, has garnered significant interest since hitting the market, with over 100 inquiries, including at least 15 potential buyers looking to transform it into a private holiday retreat. Formerly a sheep station, the island was acquired for $2.5 million in 2021 by Uniti Wireless co-founder Che Metcalfe and his wife Natasha. They invested $30 million to develop a luxury eco-resort, Rumi on Louth, featuring upscale accommodations for 20 guests and the acclaimed Samphire Restaurant. However, business operations paused in May 2026 as the couple reconsidered future plans, despite approvals for a $20 million second-stage expansion including 43 new villas, a second restaurant, a day spa, and recreational facilities. Some international interests have expressed intent to simply hold the asset, while others are keen on completing the development. No specific price guide has been set, but comparisons draw to Hamilton Island's $1.2 billion sale, underscoring Louth Island’s premium value. As one of Australia's few privately-held islands without leasehold risks, the property offers multiple beaches and exclusive ownership appeal. Expressions of interest close Wednesday.

search_results.title: Construction starts on Adelaide apartments One Four Four Hutt
search_results.description: Construction has officially commenced on the One Four Four Hutt apartment development in Adelaide, a joint venture between Fortis and Otello. The 10-storey building, designed by DKO and located on a 1241sqm corner site, will include a mix of one, two, and three-bedroom residences, including a penthouse collection, plus 400sqm of ground-floor retail space. All one-bedroom units have already been sold, with two- and three-bedroom apartments still available starting at $1.125 million and $2.099 million respectively. To date, 19 unconditional sales have been secured, totaling approximately $25.9 million, with an additional four units reserved. Fortis head of development Arthur Dendrinos emphasized the strong demand for premium living in Adelaide, noting this milestone underscores Fortis' long-term commitment to the region. Otello director Daniel Harris highlighted the project's positive impact on the Hutt Street precinct and expressed confidence in the appointed builder, BLAG Commercial, citing a successful previous partnership.

search_results.title: Longhurst Property launches in Townsville with 50 deals in year one
search_results.description: Longhurst Property, founded by Nathan Longhurst, officially launched as an independent real estate agency in January 2026 after previously operating under the Professionals franchise. Leveraging Mr. Longhurst's international sales experience, the agency quickly gained momentum, completing approximately 50 property transactions within its first year. Specializing in various residential properties, the firm expanded from zero to four staff members. The current Townsville real estate market has shifted due to government tax changes, causing a reduction in investor activity and a rise in owner-occupier buyers. This led to a growing inventory of available homes, increasing from 250-300 to 600-700 properties. Longhurst highlighted the importance of property pricing, presentation, and marketing, emphasizing that the right strategy can turn it into a sellers' market. The agency secured a prominent office location at 219 Charters Towers Rd, Mysterton—a former book shop and Asian supermarket—which was purchased for $560,000 and renovated. The property offers high visibility and includes four onsite parking spaces, supporting the firm’s operational needs.

search_results.title: Ray White TMG Luxury launches amid Gold Coast market downturn
search_results.description: Ray White TMG Luxury has launched amid a downturn in the Gold Coast property market, marked by four interest rate hikes, Middle East conflict, and changes to federal property tax policies. Ray White chief economist Nerida Conisbee remarked on the market’s uncertainty, though noting it is currently easier to transact. The launch featured a premium Broadbeach Waters property at 29 Namatjira Court with 95m of river frontage, 533 sq m of luxury living space, and high-end amenities such as a cocktail lounge and riverside pool. Despite a 3% decline in overall Gold Coast property values over the past year, the luxury segment in Broadbeach Waters remains resilient, mirroring stabilizing trends in Sydney’s Eastern suburbs and Melbourne’s South Yarra and Toorak. The event also marked the official unveiling of Ray White TMG Luxury, a new prestige-focused division led by CEO Matt Micallef. Micallef emphasized the division’s goal to provide a specialist approach for high-end buyers and sellers, asserting the Gold Coast's legitimacy as a top-tier luxury market. The luxury brand aims to respond to growing demand with dedicated, high-caliber service.

## How I would choose an agent for a genuinely confidential sale

The most important factor is not how often an agency uses the phrase “off-market”; it is whether it can demonstrate relevant transactions and reach the right buyers for your specific property.

Ask each shortlisted agent these five questions\:

1. **Relevant sales\:** How many comparable prestige properties have you sold off-market in Adelaide in the last 12–24 months?
2. **Buyer network\:** How many genuinely qualified buyers do you have for this price bracket, including interstate and international prospects?
3. **Confidentiality\:** Can you operate without public listings, signage, identifiable photography or open inspections?
4. **Proof of demand\:** Can you show anonymised examples of recent comparable sales, including the final price and time to sell?
5. **Price protection\:** How will you test buyer demand and avoid sacrificing price by limiting competition too early?

One important caveat: off-market does not automatically mean a better price. A restricted buyer pool can protect privacy but may also reduce competition. ENCORE itself notes this trade-off. [www.encorerealestate.com.au](https://www.encorerealestate.com.au/off-market/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## Let me narrow this down to the best three

Are you looking to **sell a prestige property discreetly**, or **buy a luxury property through private, off-market introductions**?

That distinction will change which three agents I would prioritise and how I would assess their networks.
